words.gloss: the one to be marched against
the one about to be marched upon
words.gram: m. nom. sg. fut. pass. part. abhi-√yā

hindi: जिस पर चढ़ाई की जानी है, जिस पर चढ़ाई होने वाली है, सन्धि के कारण को ग्रहण करने की इच्छा वाला अथवा नष्ट करने की इच्छा वाला, सामवायिकों में से किसी एक से लाभ की दुगुनी मात्रा पर सौदा करे।
english: The one to be marched against [or] the one about to be marched upon, wishing either to take up or to destroy the cause of peace, should bargain with any one of the confederates for double the gain.
notes: Subject: yātavyaḥ and abhiyāsyamānaḥ stand side by side with no vā; '[or]' is supplied in English only. 'sandhi-kāraṇam ādātu-kāmaḥ' is literal (wishing to take up / to destroy the cause of peace). sāmavāyika = member of a samavāya (association), rendered 'confederate'. paṇeta from √paṇ 'bargain, stake'; sandhi = peace as in Books 8-9.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √paṇ

words.gloss: losses, expenditures, absences abroad, setbacks, benefits to others, bodily harms

hindi: सौदा करता हुआ इसके क्षय, व्यय, प्रवास, प्रत्यवाय, दूसरों के उपकार और शरीर की बाधाओं का वर्णन करे।
english: While bargaining, [he] should describe his losses, expenditures, absences abroad, setbacks, benefits to others and bodily harms.
notes: ca closes the dvandva list ('...bodily harms and'); asya taken as 'his' (the one bargained with, or the bargainer: ambiguous). pratyavāya = setback (also 'hindrance, sin'); para-upakāra = benefit to others (alt. 'help from others'); ābādhā = harm, affliction.

words.gram: m. acc. sg. past part. prati-√pad

hindi: स्वीकार कर लेने वाले को अर्थ से जोड़े।
english: [He] should unite the one who has accepted with gain.
notes: artha rendered 'gain' (9.7 line of the glossary); alternative 'wealth' or 'object'. Object/subject unstated.

hindi: अथवा दूसरों से वैर पकड़वाकर विसंवाद कराए।
english: Or, having caused enmity to be seized by the others, [he] should cause [him] to disagree.
notes: visaṃvādayet: literal 'cause to disagree / contradict'; alternatives 'make break his word', 'cause to be deceived'. grāhayitvā literal 'having caused to be seized' (glossary 9.6); the sense 'made to adopt' is possible. pare = the others, not 'enemies'.

words.gloss: one whose undertaking is badly begun
allied with the one to be marched against
in difficulty over an immediate object

words.gram: m. nom. sg. past part. a-vi-√śvas

hindi: जिसका कर्म बुरी तरह आरम्भ हुआ है उसे क्षय और व्यय से अधिक जोड़ने की इच्छा वाला, अथवा भली-भाँति आरम्भ की हुई यात्रा की सिद्धि को नष्ट करने की इच्छा वाला, मूल पर अथवा यात्रा पर प्रहार करने की इच्छा वाला, यातव्य से मिला हुआ, फिर माँगने की इच्छा वाला, वर्तमान अर्थ में कठिनाई वाला, अथवा उसमें अविश्वास करने वाला, वर्तमान में थोड़ा लाभ चाहे, भविष्य में बहुत।
english: [One] wishing to burden further, with loss and expenditure, one whose undertaking is badly begun, or wishing to thwart the success of a well begun expedition, wishing to strike at the base or at the expedition, allied with the one to be marched against, wishing to ask again, in difficulty over an immediate object, or distrustful of him, should desire a small gain in the present, a great one in the future.
notes: One long list of nominative adjectives with no finite verb until icchet; the commas are the translator's. 'sv.ārabdhāṃ' read su-ārabdhām (su+ā > svā, in contrast with dur-ārabdha at the start); alternative sva-ārabdhām 'begun by himself'. Whose expedition is meant (the other's) is not stated. bhūyaḥ 'further/more'. artha in pratyutpanna-artha-kṛcchra taken as 'object' (alt. 'need', 'wealth'). yoktu-kāmaḥ with instrumental: wishing to burden/join with loss and expenditure.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. ava-√īkṣ

hindi: मित्र के उपकार, शत्रु के उपघात, अर्थ के अनुबन्ध को देखता हुआ, पहले उपकार करने वाले को फिर कराने की इच्छा वाला, वर्तमान में बड़ा लाभ छोड़कर भविष्य में थोड़ा चाहे।
english: Looking to the benefit to an ally, the injury to an enemy, [and] the sequel of gain, wishing to cause the earlier benefactor [to act] further, [one] should, having given up a great gain in the present, desire a small one in the future.
notes: kārayitu-kāmaḥ has no stated object of the action (what the benefactor is to do is not said); bhūyaḥ taken as 'further'. artha-anubandha: anubandha = sequel (9.7). The three accusatives are a list with no ca; '[and]' in English only.

words.gloss: by the treasonable and the enemy

words.gram: m. acc. sg. past part. vi-√grah

hindi: दूष्य और शत्रु से, मूल का हरण करने वाले से अथवा अधिक बलवान से आक्रान्त की रक्षा करने की इच्छा वाला, वैसा उपकार कराने की इच्छा वाला, अथवा सम्बन्ध को देखने वाला, वर्तमान में और भविष्य में लाभ स्वीकार न करे।
english: Wishing to protect one attacked by the treasonable and the enemy, by a base-seizer or by a stronger one, wishing to have such a benefit done, or looking to the relationship, [one] should not accept gain, both in the present and in the future.
notes: mūla-hara literal 'taking the base/capital' (usurper or seizer of the root); sense not imported. vigṛhīta 'attacked, set at war with'. The first member pair has no vā; vā stands once after mūla-hareṇa. 'tadātve ca āyatyāṃ ca' = both ... and.

words.gloss: breaking up of the peace of ally and enemy

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √śaṅk
m. acc. sg. past part. a-pra-√āp

hindi: सन्धि कर चुका हुआ, उल्लंघन करने की इच्छा वाला, दूसरे की प्रकृतियों को क्षीण करने अथवा मित्र और शत्रु की सन्धि को तोड़ने की इच्छा वाला, दूसरे के आक्रमण से शंका करता हुआ, न प्राप्त हुआ लाभ अथवा अधिक माँगे।
english: One who has made peace, wishing to transgress [it], [or] wishing to weaken the other's constituent elements or to break up the peace of ally and enemy, suspecting attack from the other, should ask for a gain not yet obtained, or more.
notes: '[or]' is supplied in English only. mitra-amitra-sandhi-viśleṣaṇa: literally the breaking of the peace(s) of ally and enemy; Kangle-style 'alliances with friends and enemies' is an alternative. para-abhiyoga taken as attack by the other (alt. accusation). 'lābham aprāptam adhikaṃ vā': 'a gain not yet obtained, or more'.

hindi: उसे, दूसरा वर्तमान में और भविष्य में क्रम को देखे।
english: The other should look to him, [and] to the sequence, both in the present and in the future.
notes: Syntax uncertain: tam (acc.) and kramam (acc.) both depend on avekṣeta; the sense may be 'the other should look to the sequence [of events] regarding him'. '[and]' supplied in English only. krama = sequence/course/order.

words.gram: m. nom. pl. past part. vi-ā-√khyā

hindi: इससे पूर्व वालों की व्याख्या की गई।
english: By that, the earlier [ones] are explained.
notes: Formula 'tena X vyākhyātāḥ'; pūrve = the earlier (cases), no noun stated.

words.gloss: of the enemy and the conqueror

words.gram: m. gen. du. pres. part. anu-√grah

words.gloss: from [allies] undertaking the feasible, the fit, the auspicious, steady in action, with devoted constituent elements

hindi: किन्तु शत्रु और विजिगीषु के अपने-अपने मित्र पर अनुग्रह करने पर शक्य, कल्य, भव्य कार्य आरम्भ करने वाले, स्थिर कर्म वाले, अनुरक्त प्रकृति वालों से भेद।
english: But, when the enemy and the conqueror each favour his own ally, the difference [comes] from [those] who undertake the feasible, the fit, the auspicious, who are steady in action, [and] whose constituent elements are devoted.
notes: The long compound is a dvandva of five types: śakya-ārambhin, kalya-ārambhin, bhavya-ārambhin, sthira-karman, anurakta-prakṛti (ārambhi is shared by the first three); units 12-14 explain them in turn. Genitive dual with participle read as a genitive absolute ('when ... favour'). Predicate of viśeṣaḥ unstated. kalya 'fit' (alt. 'sound, ready'); bhavya 'auspicious' (alt. 'prosperous'). prakṛti here = constituent elements (alt. 'nature').

hindi: शक्य का आरम्भ करने वाला सहने योग्य कर्म आरम्भ करता है, कल्य का आरम्भ करने वाला निर्दोष, भव्य का आरम्भ करने वाला कल्याण-उदय वाला।
english: The undertaker of the feasible undertakes manageable action; the undertaker of the fit, [action that is] faultless; the undertaker of the auspicious, [action that has] an auspicious outcome.
notes: In the second and third clauses karma and ārabhate are understood; English brackets only. viṣahya 'manageable' (that can be borne). udaya 'rise, outcome'.

hindi: स्थिर कर्म वाला पूरा किए बिना कर्म से विराम नहीं लेता।
english: One steady in action does not stop action without completing [it].
notes: na ... asamāpya: 'not (stop) without having completed'; karma taken as the object of uparamate (alt. ablative-like 'from action').

words.gloss: one whose constituent elements are devoted

hindi: अनुरक्त प्रकृति वाला अच्छे सहायकों के होने से थोड़े अनुग्रह से भी कार्य सिद्ध करता है।
english: One whose constituent elements are devoted accomplishes the task even with a small favour, because of having good helpers.

hindi: वे ये कृतार्थ सुख से और बहुत उपकार करते हैं।
english: Those, these, their purpose accomplished, help easily and greatly.
notes: 'te ete' (written ta ete) = 'those, these', both rendered. The referent (the allies of the types in units 11-14) is not stated. sukhena 'easily' (alt. 'happily').

hindi: अतः विपरीत अनुग्रह किए जाने योग्य नहीं।
english: Therefore the contrary [ones] are not to be favoured.
notes: pratiloma 'contrary' (literally 'against the grain'); it is not the caste sense of Book 3. The contrary ones are the opposites of the types in units 11-14.

words.gloss: in the favouring of one person

hindi: उन दोनों के एक पुरुष पर अनुग्रह करने में जो मित्र पर अथवा मित्रतर पर अनुग्रह करता है, वह छल लेता है।
english: Of those two, in the favouring of one person, he who favours an ally or a closer ally outwits.

text_flags.why: possible stray compound dot: -tara is a comparative suffix, not a member; unit 20 prints mitrataraṃ

notes: 'in the favouring of one person' = when the two favour the same person (the object of unit 11's allies); sense of the unit: the one who favours an ally or closer ally outwits the other. mitra-tara 'closer ally' (literally 'more of an ally').

words.gloss: losses, expenditures, absences abroad, benefits to others

hindi: क्योंकि मित्र से स्वयं की वृद्धि प्राप्त करता है, दूसरा क्षय, व्यय, प्रवास, दूसरों के उपकारों को।
english: For [one] obtains growth of himself from an ally; the other, [obtains] losses, expenditures, absences abroad, [and] benefits to others.
notes: The verb is not repeated for itaraḥ; English supplies '[obtains]' in brackets, Hindi leaves the clause open. Subject of prāpnoti unstated. ātma = self.

hindi: और कृतार्थ शत्रु प्रतिकूलता को जाता है।
english: And an enemy whose purpose is accomplished goes to hostility.
notes: vaiguṇya literal 'lack of good qualities / deficiency'; rendered 'hostility' with viguṇa = hostile (11.1 glossary line); see unit 22.

words.gram: m. gen. du. pres. part. anu-√grah

hindi: किन्तु मध्यम पर अनुग्रह करने वाले दोनों में से जो मध्यम पर, मित्र पर अथवा मित्रतर पर अनुग्रह करता है, वह छल लेता है।
english: But of the two favouring the middle king, he who favours the middle king, [whether] an ally or a closer ally, outwits.
notes: Ambiguity: 'yo madhyamaṃ mitraṃ mitrataraṃ vā' may mean 'who favours the middle king, [being] an ally or a closer ally' (as rendered) or 'who favours the middle king's ally or closer ally'. Parallel to unit 17.

words.gloss: losses, expenditures, absences abroad, benefits to others

hindi: क्योंकि मित्र से स्वयं की वृद्धि प्राप्त करता है, दूसरा क्षय, व्यय, प्रवास, दूसरों के उपकारों को।
english: For [one] obtains growth of himself from an ally; the other, [obtains] losses, expenditures, absences abroad, [and] benefits to others.
notes: Identical to unit 18 in the e-text (repeated line, as in the edition). The verb is not repeated for itaraḥ; English supplies '[obtains]' in brackets.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. past part. anu-√grah

hindi: यदि मध्यम अनुग्रह पाकर प्रतिकूल हो जाए, शत्रु छल लेता है।
english: If the middle king, when favoured, should become hostile, the enemy outwits.
notes: viguṇa literal 'lacking good qualities'; rendered 'hostile' as in 11.1. Hindi has no 'तो' because the Sanskrit has no correlative.

words.gram: m. acc. sg. past part. apa-√sṛ

hindi: क्योंकि प्रयास किए हुए, हटे हुए, एक अर्थ को प्राप्त हुए मध्यम-शत्रु को प्राप्त करता है।
english: For [he] obtains the middle-enemy, one who has made effort, withdrawn, [and] gone to a single object.
notes: Syntax and sense doubtful: subject of prāpnoti is not stated (probably the enemy of unit 22); madhyama-amitra taken as 'the middle [king] become an enemy' (alt. 'the enemy of the middle king'). eka-artha 'single object' (alt. 'same purpose').

words.gram: m. nom. sg. past part. vi-ā-√khyā

hindi: इससे उदासीन के अनुग्रह की व्याख्या की गई।
english: By that, the favouring of the neutral king is explained.

words.gloss: to the middle and the neutral king
in the giving of a share of the army

words.gram: m. acc. sg. past part. anu-√rañj

hindi: मध्यम और उदासीन को सेना का अंश देने में जो शूर, अस्त्र में प्रशिक्षित, कष्ट सहने वाली अथवा अनुरक्त सेना देता है, वह छला जाता है।
english: In the giving of a share of the army to the middle and the neutral king, he who gives an army that is brave, trained in arms, enduring hardship, or devoted, is outwitted.
notes: daṇḍa here = army (Book 8/9 glossary lines). kṛta-astra literally 'whose weapons are made'; the usual sense 'trained in arms' is used (medium). The gen. dual madhyama-udāsīnayoḥ is read with dāne ('to'). The adjectives are neuter-agreeing with daṇḍam in sense; vā closes the list.

hindi: विपरीत छल लेता है।
english: The opposite one outwits.
notes: 'The opposite' = he who gives an army not of the kinds listed in unit 25; the noun is not stated.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. past part. pra-√hi

words.gloss: of the hereditary, hired, guild, ally and forest-tribe troops
whose place and time are ascertained
whose place and time are separated

hindi: किन्तु जहाँ भेजी गई सेना उसे अथवा, और, अर्थ को और दूसरों को सिद्ध करती है, वहाँ मौल, भृत, श्रेणी, मित्र, आटवी सेनाओं में से किसी एक, ज्ञात देश और काल वाली सेना दे, अथवा व्यवहित देश और काल वाली शत्रु और आटवी सेना।
english: But where the army sent out accomplishes him or—and—the object and others, there [one] should give an army, any one of the hereditary, hired, guild, ally and forest-tribe troops, whose place and time are ascertained, or enemy and forest-tribe troops whose place and time are separated.

text_flags.why: possible stray vā before ca-artham in the first clause (vā and ca both follow tam); the second vā of the line is sound

notes: 'taṃ vā ca-artham anyāṃś ca' has both vā and ca after tam; the grammar is doubtful (probably taṃ ca-artham anyāṃś ca, 'him, the object and others'); both particles are rendered literally as printed. 'tam' (him) = the recipient of the army. daṇḍa = army (Book 9 glossary). Troops: hereditary/hired/guild/ally/forest-tribe (9.2). upalabdha-deśa-kāla 'of ascertained place and time'; vyavahita 'separated, intervening' (alt. 'distant'). amitra-aṭavī-bala read as a dvandva (enemy troops and forest-tribe troops). dadyāt governs both objects.

words.gloss: among enemies, in forests, on unsuitable ground, out of season
on the pretext of the army's engagement

hindi: किन्तु जिसके विषय में सोचे—“कृतार्थ मेरी सेना को ले ले, शत्रु, वन, अनुपयुक्त भूमि अथवा बेमौसम में बसा दे, अथवा निष्फल कर दे”—उस पर सेना के व्यासङ्ग के बहाने अनुग्रह न करे।
english: But [him] whom [one] might think, “One whose purpose is accomplished might take my army, or lodge [it] among enemies, in forests, on unsuitable ground or out of season, or make [it] fruitless,” him [one] should not favour, on the pretext of the army's engagement.
notes: Quotation closed by iti (carried by the quotation marks, glossed 'closing particle'). The locative compound is read as a dvandva of four (enemies, forests, unsuitable ground, out of season); 'among enemies' may also be 'in enemy [territory]'. vyāsaṅga = engagement/entanglement (alt. 'being engaged elsewhere'). The object 'it' (the army) is supplied in brackets in English. gṛhṇīyāt 'take' (alt. 'keep').

hindi: इस प्रकार किन्तु अवश्य अनुग्रह किए जाने योग्य होने पर उसे उस काल को सहने वाली सेना दे।
english: But in this way, when [he] is necessarily to be favoured, [one] should give him an army able to bear that time.
notes: anugrahītavye is a locative gerundive ('when to be favoured'), subject unstated; tat-kāla-saha 'able to bear that time' (alt. 'for that time only').

hindi: और समाप्ति तक इसे बसाए और लड़ाए, और सेना के व्यसनों से रक्षा करे।
english: And until completion [one] should lodge him and make [him] fight, and should protect [him] from calamities of the army.
notes: Four ca/verb positions: ca after ā-samāpteḥ, after yodhayet, and after bala-vyasanebhyaḥ are all rendered 'and'.

words.gloss: from one whose purpose is accomplished

hindi: और कृतार्थ से बहाने सहित खिसकवाए।
english: And [one] should cause [him] to slip away, with a pretext, from [the one] whose purpose is accomplished.
notes: apasrāvayet literally 'cause to flow away'; the sense of the object (him / the army) is not stated and is bracketed in English only. kṛta-arthāt may be an ablative of separation ('from') or 'when his purpose is done'.

words.gloss: army of the treasonable, the enemy and forest tribes

hindi: अथवा इसे दूष्य, शत्रु, आटवी की सेना दे।
english: Or [one] should give him an army of the treasonable, the enemy and forest tribes.
notes: daṇḍa = army. The compound may also be read 'treasonable, enemy [and] forest troops'.

words.gloss: with the one to be marched against

hindi: अथवा यातव्य से सन्धि करके इसे छल ले।
english: Or, having made peace with the one to be marched against, [one] should outwit him.
notes: sandhi = peace (Books 8-9).

words.gloss: of the equal, the inferior and the superior

hindi: क्योंकि समान लाभ में सन्धि हो, विषम में विक्रम माना गया है; सम, हीन, विशिष्ट के सन्धि और विक्रम कहे गए हैं।
english: For in an equal gain there should be peace; in an unequal [one], attack is deemed [right]; peace and attacks have been stated for the equal, the inferior and the superior.
notes: Verse (two half-lines). The iti after sama-hīna-viśiṣṭānām closes the verse's statement and is glossed 'closing particle', not rendered. viṣame: the noun lābhe is understood. vikrama = attack (alt. 'prowess, valour').
